# Nalin Jayasinghe

Chartered Architect | Director / Co-Principal Architect - JAN Merkaba (Pvt) Ltd. | RIBA/AIA(SL)

Ipswich, England, United Kingdom (GB)

78 connections • 78 followers

## About

A practicing Chartered Architect with over 20 years of professional experience in the field of Architecture within Sri Lanka and abroad. A Chartered member of RIBA and SLIA. Director and co-principal architect at JAN Merkaba (Pvt.) Ltd. – Chartered Architects and Designers in Sri Lanka with experience in carrying out projects in Sri Lanka, Italy, Kazakhstan and India. Has been involved in Many large scale projects in Housing, Hospitals, Hotels and University Designs. Highly skilled in architectural design and architectural technology with extensive experience in construction management and construction detailing. Expert in carrying out building renovation designs and conservation of historic buildings. A part time university academic with teaching experience in Architectural Design, Experiencing Architecture and Building Technology at 3 Sri Lankan universities.

Total Experience: 25 years and 6 months
